## History

The exact value 16 was already recorded in Remark 1 of Zhang-Luo-Shigeno (2015), DOI 10.1007/s00373-014-1422-4. The contribution is the complete 35-class minimum classification, not a new exact value or upper bound. The n+3 pattern breaks: exhaustive enumeration finds no C6-saturated graph through 15 edges, with all 1581347 generated classes counted against independent Burnside totals. This 16-edge witness passes two independent cycle checks and attains the lower bound. It is obtained from the n=9 witness HyOkc?\` by attaching a path of length four between vertices 3 and 8. Complete generation through 16 edges classifies 35 minimum graphs, all independently checked; Python and compiled checkers agree on the entire family. Full graph6 family and logs are preserved in the research repository. Canonical lookup found no match immediately before submission. The v4 archive and HoG record were published and checked live on 2026-10-18; the downloaded canonical graph passes isomorphism and saturation checks.
